name: Step Up with Knee Drive
steps: Stand facing a sturdy box or step.
Place your whole left foot on top.
Push through the left heel to stand up on the box.
Drive the right knee up to hip height.
Step back down with control. Finish the set, then switch legs.
cues: Stand fully tall at the top
Breathe out as you step up

common_mistakes.fix: Lift with the top leg only
Use a step where your knee is at or below hip level
